data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall favourable prior-year reserve movement of GBP 1.922m (a release) at year end, driven primarily by a GBP 5.89m improvement on reinsurance acceptances which was partially offset by adverse development of GBP 1.621m in Marine and GBP 2.094m in Property (Fire and other damage). The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 231.724m. The movement reflects a mix of favourable and adverse claims development across classes, with prior major events such as Superstorm Sandy and other large losses continuing to influence run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 1,922,000 on prior year's provisions was experienced during the year.

An improvement of GBP 5,890,000 on reinsurance acceptances was partially offset by deteriorations of GBP 1,621,000 on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 2,094,000 on fire and other damage to property.

It is the reduced level of losses, as a result of the re-underwriting that began to be implemented late in 2011 and on into 2012, that has continued to keep attrition below expectation for this year thus improving the actual return above levels previously predicted.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (explicitly states GBP 1,922,000 improvement). The note presents amounts without explicit column labels; treated as gross movements per the note heading. Minor residual differences exist between the sum of line movements quoted and the overall improvement figure (likely due to other smaller class movements not itemised). No gross claims development triangle was found in the published pages, so triangle-based cross-check was not possible.
